title: sidereus-state v1
description: Public, versioned snapshot of Sidereus (GET /api/v1/state). CONFORMANCE (MUST): this document carries metadata only. No field may carry the content of gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.system_instructions, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments or gen_ai.tool.call.result. The only free-text fields are sessions[].sub[].lab, sessions[].plm.title, sessions[].runs[].cur, the keys of sessions[].runs[].stages (pipeline stage titles from the pipeline definition) and rooms.*.topic, each a one-line label set by the parent agent, pipeline author or room owner, never a message body or tool input. Producers MUST drop anything else rather than add it here; consumers MUST NOT expect conversation content. OTel GenAI mapping (INFORMATIVE — the semantic conventions are still Development and may change): sid -> gen_ai.conversation.id; model -> gen_ai.request.model; plat -> gen_ai.provider.name (cc -> anthropic, cx -> openai, gm -> gcp.gemini); sub[].lab -> gen_ai.agent.name / gen_ai.agent.description ("<agentType>: <description>"); sub[].aid -> gen_ai.agent.id; tool -> gen_ai.tool.name. A block whose feature is switched off is omitted.

pct.description: Five-hour usage % the decision used; null when unknown.

x.description: UNSTABLE extension bag — the only open object at the top level; keys may change without a version bump.

plat.description: Platform key: cc (Claude Code), cx (Codex), gm (Gemini), ... (sidereus/ext_store.py EXT_PLAT).

state.description: think | tool | wait | ask | done | unknown (open set).

ctx.description: Context tokens of the last response.

tool.description: Tool name only — never its input.

runs.description: Recorded pipeline runs (head run plus up to 5 earlier runs per name), newest t0 first; absent when the session has none.

acct.description: Claude config root label; present only for a non-primary root.

end.description: End, Unix seconds; null while open.

verdict.description: fail = a stage failed; pass = ended, not stopped, last stage of the definition done or skipped; else unknown.

stages.description: Stage title -> state (run | done | skip | back | fail | hold, open set).

idle.description: Seconds since its own log last moved.
